body.name: \mathsf H_{\mathrm{crit}}
body.construction: Derive bias-compensated local likelihoods indexed jointly by cutoff and effect label; solve the normalized optimal-recovery problem for the compliance and outcome compensation profiles; truncate and renormalize the translated-cutoff mixtures at the support boundary; retain the effect-label coordinate in the testing experiment; and invert the resulting tests before taking the shortest honest connected hull.
